# Psalm 119 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

### ALEPH

**1** Blessed the-blameless-of way, the-walkers in-law-of YHWH.

**2** Blessed the-keepers-of his-testimonies; with-all the-heart they-seek-him.

**3** Also not they-have-done unrighteousness; in-his-ways they-have-walked.

**4** You have-commanded your-precepts to-keep diligently.

**5** O-that would-be-established my-ways to-keep your-statutes!

**6** Then not I-will-be-ashamed, when-I-look to all your-commandments.

**7** I-will-give-thanks-to-you with-uprightness-of heart, when-I-learn judgments-of your-righteousness.

**8** Your-statutes I-will-keep; do-not forsake-me utterly.

### BETH

**9** With-what will-keep-pure a-young-man his-path? By-keeping according-to your-word.

**10** With-all my-heart I-have-sought-you; do-not let-me-wander from-your-commandments.

**11** In-my-heart I-have-treasured your-saying, so-that not I-will-sin against-you.

**12** Blessed you O-YHWH; teach-me your-statutes.

**13** With-my-lips I-have-recounted all the-judgments-of your-mouth.

**14** In-way-of your-testimonies I-have-rejoiced, as-over all riches.

**15** In-your-precepts I-will-meditate, and-I-will-look-at your-paths.

**16** In-your-statutes I-will-delight; not I-will-forget your-word.

### GIMEL

**17** Deal-bountifully with-your-servant; let-me-live and-I-will-keep your-word.

**18** Open my-eyes and-let-me-behold wonders from-your-law.

**19** A-sojourner I on-the-earth; do-not hide from-me your-commandments.

**20** Is-crushed my-soul with-longing for your-judgments at-all times.

**21** You-have-rebuked the-arrogant, the-cursed, who-wander from-your-commandments.

**22** Roll from-me reproach and-contempt, for your-testimonies I-have-kept.

**23** Also princes sat, against-me they-spoke; your-servant meditates on-your-statutes.

**24** Also your-testimonies my-delight, my-counselors.

### DALETH

**25** Clings to-the-dust my-soul; revive-me according-to your-word.

**26** My-ways I-have-recounted and-you-answered-me; teach-me your-statutes.

**27** The-way-of your-precepts make-me-understand, and-I-will-meditate on your-wonders.

**28** Weeps my-soul from-sorrow; raise-me-up according-to your-word.

**29** Way-of falsehood remove from-me, and-your-law be-gracious-to-me.

**30** Way-of faithfulness I-have-chosen; your-judgments I-have-set-before-me.

**31** I-have-clung to-your-testimonies O-YHWH; do-not put-me-to-shame.

**32** The-way-of your-commandments I-will-run, for you-will-enlarge my-heart.

### HE

**33** Teach-me O-YHWH the-way-of your-statutes, and-I-will-keep-it to-the-end.

**34** Give-me-understanding and-I-will-observe your-law, and-I-will-keep-it with-all the-heart.

**35** Lead-me in-path-of your-commandments, for in-it I-delight.

**36** Incline my-heart to-your-testimonies, and-not to-unjust-gain.

**37** Turn-away my-eyes from-seeing vanity; in-your-way revive-me.

**38** Establish to-your-servant your-saying, which to-your-fear.

**39** Turn-away my-reproach which I-dread, for your-judgments are-good.

**40** Behold I-have-longed for-your-precepts; in-your-righteousness revive-me.

### VAV

**41** And-let-come-to-me your-steadfast-love O-YHWH, your-salvation according-to your-saying.

**42** And-I-will-answer the-one-reproaching-me a-word, for I-trust in-your-word.

**43** And-do-not snatch from-my-mouth the-word-of truth utterly, for in-your-judgments I-have-hoped.

**44** And-I-will-keep your-law continually, to-forever and-ever.

**45** And-I-will-walk in-a-broad-place, for your-precepts I-have-sought.

**46** And-I-will-speak-of your-testimonies before kings, and-not I-will-be-ashamed.

**47** And-I-will-delight in-your-commandments, which I-have-loved.

**48** And-I-will-lift my-hands to-your-commandments which I-have-loved, and-I-will-meditate on-your-statutes.

### ZAYIN

**49** Remember the-word to-your-servant, upon which you-have-caused-me-to-hope.

**50** This my-comfort in-my-affliction, for your-saying has-revived-me.

**51** The-arrogant have-mocked-me utterly; from-your-law not I-have-turned-aside.

**52** I-have-remembered your-judgments from-of-old O-YHWH, and-I-comfort-myself.

**53** Burning-indignation has-seized-me because-of the-wicked, forsakers-of your-law.

**54** Songs have-been to-me your-statutes, in-house-of my-sojourning.

**55** I-have-remembered in-the-night your-name O-YHWH, and-I-keep your-law.

**56** This has-been to-me, for your-precepts I-have-kept.

### CHETH

**57** My-portion YHWH; I-have-said to-keep your-words.

**58** I-have-entreated your-face with-all the-heart; be-gracious-to-me according-to your-saying.

**59** I-have-considered my-ways, and-I-have-turned my-feet to your-testimonies.

**60** I-have-hastened and-not delayed to-keep your-commandments.

**61** Cords-of the-wicked have-ensnared-me; your-law not I-have-forgotten.

**62** At-middle-of the-night I-arise to-give-thanks to-you, on-account-of judgments-of your-righteousness.

**63** A-companion I to-all who fear-you, and-to-keepers-of your-precepts.

**64** Your-steadfast-love O-YHWH has-filled the-earth; your-statutes teach-me.

### TETH

**65** Good you-have-done with-your-servant, O-YHWH, according-to your-word.

**66** Goodness-of discernment and-knowledge teach-me, for in-your-commandments I-have-believed.

**67** Before I-was-afflicted I was-going-astray, and-now your-saying I-keep.

**68** Good you and-doing-good; teach-me your-statutes.

**69** Have-smeared upon-me falsehood the-arrogant; I with-all the-heart keep your-precepts.

**70** Is-gross like-fat their-heart; I in-your-law delight.

**71** Good for-me that I-was-afflicted, so-that I-might-learn your-statutes.

**72** Good to-me the-law-of your-mouth, more-than thousands-of gold and-silver.

### YODH

**73** Your-hands have-made-me and-established-me; give-me-understanding and-I-will-learn your-commandments.

**74** Those-fearing-you will-see-me and-be-glad, for in-your-word I-have-hoped.

**75** I-know O-YHWH that righteous your-judgments, and-in-faithfulness you-have-afflicted-me.

**76** Let-be please your-steadfast-love to-comfort-me, according-to your-saying to-your-servant.

**77** Let-come-to-me your-compassion and-I-will-live, for your-law my-delight.

**78** Let-be-ashamed the-arrogant, for with-falsehood they-have-subverted-me; I will-meditate on-your-precepts.

**79** Let-turn to-me those-fearing-you, and-those-knowing your-testimonies.

**80** Let-be my-heart blameless in-your-statutes, so-that not I-will-be-ashamed.

### KAPH

**81** Has-pined for-your-salvation my-soul; in-your-word I-have-hoped.

**82** Have-pined my-eyes for-your-saying, saying, 'When will-you-comfort-me?'

**83** For I-have-become like-a-wineskin in-smoke; your-statutes not I-have-forgotten.

**84** How-many the-days-of your-servant? When will-you-execute against-my-persecutors judgment?

**85** Have-dug for-me the-arrogant pits, which not according-to your-law.

**86** All your-commandments faithfulness; with-falsehood they-persecute-me — help-me!

**87** Almost they-have-consumed-me on-the-earth; and-I not have-forsaken your-precepts.

**88** According-to your-steadfast-love revive-me, and-I-will-keep the-testimony-of your-mouth.

### LAMEDH

**89** To-forever O-YHWH, your-word is-established in-the-heavens.

**90** To-generation and-generation your-faithfulness; you-established the-earth and-it-stands.

**91** By-your-judgments they-stand today, for all your-servants.

**92** If-not your-law my-delight, then I-would-have-perished in-my-affliction.

**93** To-forever not I-will-forget your-precepts, for by-them you-have-revived-me.

**94** To-you I, save-me, for your-precepts I-have-sought.

**95** For-me have-waited the-wicked to-destroy-me; your-testimonies I-consider.

**96** To-all perfection I-have-seen an-end; broad your-commandment very.

### MEM

**97** How I-love your-law! All the-day it my-meditation.

**98** More-than-my-enemies you-make-me-wise by-your-commandments, for to-forever it to-me.

**99** More-than-all my-teachers I-have-insight, for your-testimonies my-meditation.

**100** More-than the-aged I-understand, for your-precepts I-have-kept.

**101** From-every path evil I-have-restrained my-feet, so-that I-might-keep your-word.

**102** From-your-judgments not I-have-turned-aside, for you have-taught-me.

**103** How sweet to-my-palate your-sayings, more-than-honey to-my-mouth!

**104** From-your-precepts I-gain-understanding; therefore I-hate every path-of falsehood.

### NUN

**105** A-lamp to-my-foot your-word, and-a-light to-my-path.

**106** I-have-sworn and-I-will-confirm, to-keep judgments-of your-righteousness.

**107** I-am-afflicted very; O-YHWH revive-me according-to your-word.

**108** Freewill-offerings-of my-mouth accept-please O-YHWH, and-your-judgments teach-me.

**109** My-soul in-my-hand continually, and-your-law not I-have-forgotten.

**110** Have-set the-wicked a-snare for-me, and-from-your-precepts not I-have-wandered.

**111** I-have-inherited your-testimonies to-forever, for the-joy-of my-heart they-are.

**112** I-have-inclined my-heart to-do your-statutes, to-forever to-the-end.

### SAMEKH

**113** Double-minded I-hate, and-your-law I-love.

**114** My-hiding-place and-my-shield you; in-your-word I-have-hoped.

**115** Depart from-me O-evildoers, and-I-will-keep the-commandments-of my-God.

**116** Sustain-me according-to your-saying and-I-will-live, and-do-not put-me-to-shame from-my-hope.

**117** Support-me and-I-will-be-saved, and-I-will-gaze on-your-statutes continually.

**118** You-have-rejected all who-stray from-your-statutes, for falsehood their-deceit.

**119** Dross you-have-removed all the-wicked-of the-earth; therefore I-love your-testimonies.

**120** Shudders from-dread-of-you my-flesh, and-from-your-judgments I-am-afraid.

### AYIN

**121** I-have-done justice and-righteousness; do-not leave-me to-my-oppressors.

**122** Be-surety for-your-servant for-good; do-not let-oppress-me the-arrogant.

**123** My-eyes have-pined for-your-salvation, and-for-saying-of your-righteousness.

**124** Deal with-your-servant according-to your-steadfast-love, and-your-statutes teach-me.

**125** Your-servant I; give-me-understanding and-I-will-know your-testimonies.

**126** Time to-act for-YHWH; they-have-broken your-law.

**127** Therefore I-love your-commandments more-than-gold, and-more-than-fine-gold.

**128** Therefore all precepts-of all I-regard-as-right; every path-of falsehood I-hate.

### PE

**129** Wonderful your-testimonies; therefore has-kept-them my-soul.

**130** The-opening-of your-words gives-light; giving-understanding to-the-simple.

**131** My-mouth I-have-opened and-I-pant, for to-your-commandments I-long.

**132** Turn to-me and-be-gracious-to-me, as-is-fitting for-lovers-of your-name.

**133** My-steps establish in-your-saying, and-do-not let-rule over-me any iniquity.

**134** Redeem-me from-oppression-of man, and-I-will-keep your-precepts.

**135** Your-face make-shine on-your-servant, and-teach-me your-statutes.

**136** Streams-of water have-gone-down my-eyes, because not they-have-kept your-law.

### TSADHE

**137** Righteous you O-YHWH, and-upright your-judgments.

**138** You-have-commanded your-testimonies righteousness, and-faithfulness very.

**139** Has-destroyed-me my-zeal, for have-forgotten your-words my-adversaries.

**140** Refined your-saying very, and-your-servant loves-it.

**141** Small I and-despised; your-precepts not I-have-forgotten.

**142** Your-righteousness righteousness to-forever, and-your-law truth.

**143** Distress and-anguish have-found-me; your-commandments my-delight.

**144** Righteousness your-testimonies to-forever; give-me-understanding and-I-will-live.

### QOPH

**145** I-have-called with-all the-heart; answer-me O-YHWH; your-statutes I-will-keep.

**146** I-have-called-on-you, save-me, and-I-will-keep your-testimonies.

**147** I-have-risen-before the-dawn and-I-cry-for-help; in-your-words I-have-hoped.

**148** Have-anticipated my-eyes the-night-watches, to-meditate on-your-saying.

**149** My-voice hear according-to your-steadfast-love; O-YHWH according-to your-judgments revive-me.

**150** Have-drawn-near pursuers-of wickedness; from-your-law they-are-far.

**151** Near you O-YHWH, and-all your-commandments truth.

**152** Long-ago I-have-known from-your-testimonies, that to-forever you-have-founded-them.

### RESH

**153** See my-affliction and-rescue-me, for your-law not I-have-forgotten.

**154** Plead my-cause and-redeem-me; according-to your-saying revive-me.

**155** Far from-the-wicked salvation, for your-statutes not they-have-sought.

**156** Your-compassions many O-YHWH; according-to your-judgments revive-me.

**157** Many my-persecutors and-my-adversaries; from-your-testimonies not I-have-turned-aside.

**158** I-have-seen the-treacherous and-I-am-disgusted, because your-saying not they-have-kept.

**159** See that your-precepts I-have-loved; O-YHWH according-to your-steadfast-love revive-me.

**160** The-sum-of your-word truth, and-to-forever every judgment-of your-righteousness.

### SHIN

**161** Princes have-persecuted-me without-cause, and-from-your-words has-trembled my-heart.

**162** I-rejoice over your-saying, like-one-finding spoil great.

**163** Falsehood I-hate and-I-abhor; your-law I-love.

**164** Seven-times in-the-day I-praise-you, on-account-of judgments-of your-righteousness.

**165** Peace great to-lovers-of your-law, and-there-is-no for-them stumbling-block.

**166** I-have-hoped for-your-salvation O-YHWH, and-your-commandments I-have-done.

**167** Has-kept my-soul your-testimonies, and-I-love-them greatly.

**168** I-have-kept your-precepts and-your-testimonies, for all my-ways before-you.

### TAV

**169** Let-draw-near my-cry before-you O-YHWH; according-to your-word give-me-understanding.

**170** Let-come my-supplication before-you; according-to your-saying deliver-me.

**171** Let-pour-forth my-lips praise, for you-teach-me your-statutes.

**172** Let-sing my-tongue your-saying, for all your-commandments righteousness.

**173** Let-be your-hand to-help-me, for your-precepts I-have-chosen.

**174** I-have-longed for-your-salvation O-YHWH, and-your-law my-delight.

**175** Let-live my-soul and-it-will-praise-you, and-your-judgments will-help-me.

**176** I-have-wandered like-a-sheep lost; seek your-servant, for your-commandments not I-have-forgotten.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **119:1-176**: The longest chapter in the Bible: 176 verses, 22 stanzas of 8 verses each, one stanza per Hebrew letter (aleph-tav acrostic). Eight synonyms for Torah rotate throughout: law (torah), testimonies (edot), precepts (piqqudim), statutes (chuqqim), commandments (mitsvot), judgments (mishpatim), word (davar/imrah), way (derekh).

- **119:11**: 'In-my-heart I-have-treasured your-saying' — tsafanti, 'I have hidden/stored'; internalization of divine speech as protection against sin.

- **119:105**: 'A-lamp to-my-foot your-word' — the iconic metaphor: God's word illuminates the immediate next step, not the entire journey.

- **119:176**: The psalm ends not with triumph but with confession: 'I-have-wandered like-a-sheep lost.' Even 176 verses of Torah devotion culminate in need for the divine Shepherd.

— EMET
